full_name: Claire Luchette | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Fiction & Poetry Lisa Goldberg Fellow Binghamton University
bio: Claire Luchette is the author of the novel Agatha of Little Neon (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2021). At Radcliffe, Luchette will work on a second novel, about the mail.
